scope: Audit existing seller journey; no business implementation or staging change

criteria.requirement: Registration is pending; native membership is not commercial approval or a DIDAR identity merge.
criteria.reuse: Native Member/Seller registration and lifecycle; existing DIDAR supplier registration
criteria.extension: Separate canonical supplier and explicit native linkage
criteria.evidence: real registration UI, pending read, denied commerce before approval

criteria.requirement: Only authorized Admin reviews/approves commercial eligibility; native approval alone does not grant gold writes.
criteria.reuse: Native Admin seller approval and permission resolver
criteria.extension: Canonical supplier approval plus independently revocable gold grants
criteria.evidence: Admin review UI/API, pending/rejected and cross-tenant negatives

criteria.requirement: DIDAR may launch an eligible same-supplier storefront without merchant Vendor login; optional handover uses the same records.
criteria.reuse: Native Admin/Vendor SDK extensions and selected Seller
criteria.evidence: Admin-managed setup, public store, subsequent same-record Vendor access; distinguish empty setup from sellable store

criteria.requirement: Gold product proposal needs explicit REQUEST_PRODUCT_CREATION, canonical review and taxonomy before publication; rejection creates no product/stock.
criteria.reuse: Native panel route, linked Medusa Product projection
criteria.extension: Existing didar_product_request, Product Master and classification authority
criteria.evidence: native proposal UI, denied without grant, rejected request, approved exact ID/native link

criteria.requirement: Offer terms and actual available stock follow explicit grants and exact UID intake; proposed terms are not a sellable Offer or fabricated stock.
criteria.extension: Existing didar_offer/itemized inventory and intake workflows
criteria.evidence: proposal-vs-Offer distinction, native generic writes denied, canonical grant/revocation, synthetic exact UID intake via API only

criteria.requirement: Reject, suspension, revocation and foreign-tenant attempts remain denied server-side; historical authority is preserved.
criteria.extension: Existing supplier status, native actor bridge and action grants
criteria.evidence: real HTTP negatives, unchanged rejected request, no duplicate stock/order/payment writers

criteria.requirement: Preview has stable Internet HTTPS URL, isolated synthetic resources, applicable checks and safe update/access/recording.
criteria.reuse: Existing exact-SHA CI, packaged images, signed-ingress QA and browser tools
criteria.extension: Verification workflow and acceptance-to-evidence report only
criteria.evidence: separate hosting preflight, source SHA, secure access reference, actual journey recording; BLOCKED if no compatible hosting

unresolved_decisions: Compatible isolated Internet hosting and secure test-access channel are not provisioned.
No approved Vercel-specific original-client attribution/shared-namespace adapter is established by project discovery.
Do not unify native and DIDAR identity/commerce authorities or enable generic native writes during this audit.
Cross-supplier resale, statutory acceptance, live providers and later feature phases are outside scope.
